description: Tool name -> tool kind, per surface. Kinds: read, edit, create, terminal, search, subagent, mcp, web, skill, meta. Unknown tools get kind 'other'.

vscode.source: Copilot SDK engine recordings 2026-10-01 (VS Code 1.140.0, @github/copilot 1.0.89-7); WebFetch, skill, tool_search_tool, task_complete and AskUserQuestion recorded 2026-10-10. The older names (read_file ... runSubagent) come from the B1 recording 2026-09-30; a subagent in a Copilot (SDK) session still uses some of them.
vscode.unrecorded_note: Edit tools named in VS Code, never recorded here under these names (`apply_patch` reaches the hook as `Edit` with plain text). The gate needs them as 'edit'; their input shapes are read generically (nested filePath, patch headers). `bash`, `PowerShell` and `powershell` are guesses for the terminal tool of a Copilot session on Windows (never recorded there; the permission dialog on macOS shows `bash`), listed so the gate reads their `command` whatever the name. Record them when seen.
